HN 不需要凭证；这里检查能不能连上 HN 的两个接口，并核对监听的用户名是否存: HN needs no credential; this checks that both HN APIs are reachable and that the watched username exists
HN 地址里 item?id= 后面那串数字，也可以直接粘整个地址: The number after item?id= in an HN address; the whole address can be pasted too
parent_id 是监听账号写的帖子或评论: parent_id is a story or comment written by the watched account
也可以直接粘 HN 地址: An HN address can be pasted too
事件源自动维护，勿手填: Maintained by the event source; do not fill in
你的 HN 账号。它最近发的帖子下有新评论、或有人回复它的评论时触发「有新评论」: Your HN account. Fires "New comment" when its recent stories get comments or someone replies to its comments; empty = not watched
出现这个词的新帖子或新评论触发「关键词命中」，如项目名或 github.com/: New stories or comments containing this term fire "Keyword matched", e.g. your project name or github.com/you/repo; empty = not watched
取一条帖子下的全部评论，按讨论顺序平铺（带层级）。可只取某个时刻之后的新评论: All comments under a story, flattened in discussion order (with depth). Can be limited to comments after a given time
只在「取评论」里有意义：1 = 直接回复帖子，2 = 回复评论，以此类推: Only meaningful in "Get comments": 1 = direct reply to the story, 2 = reply to a comment, and so on
如 http://127.0.0.1:7897；部署环境直连不了 news.yc: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7897; required when the deployment cannot reach news.ycombinator.com directly
帖子 id 或上一条评论的 id；与 story_id 相同表示直接回复帖子: A story id, or the previous comment's id; equal to story_id means a direct reply to the story
帖子 id 或地址，多个用逗号分隔。别人替你发的帖子、或你想跟进的讨论放这里: Story ids or addresses, comma-separated: stories someone else posted for you, or discussions you want to follow
帖子的分数；评论没有公开分数，为 0: A story's points; comments have no public score, so 0
帖子的评论总数；评论为 0: A story's total comment count; 0 for comments
按 id 读一条帖子或评论（得分、评论数、正文、作者）: Reads one story or comment by id (points, comment count, text, author)
按关键词搜帖子和评论，最新的在前。看谁在讨论你的项目就用它: Searches stories and comments by keyword, newest first. Use it to see who is discussing your project
由 text_html 去掉标签、还原转义得到；链接保留完整地址: text_html with tags stripped and entities decoded; links keep their full address
由 text_html 去掉标签、还原转义得到；链接帖通常为空: text_html with tags stripped and entities decoded; usually empty for link stories
讨论帖与评论有；链接帖为空: Present for text stories and comments; empty for link stories
讨论顺序（先父后子），depth 是层级: Discussion order (parent before children); depth is the level
评论回复的是哪一条（帖子或另一条评论）；帖子为空: What the comment replies to (the story or another comment); empty for stories
评论所在的帖子；帖子本身为自己的 id: The story the comment is in; a story's own id for stories
读榜单、帖子、评论，按关键词搜索；有人评论你的帖子、或回复你的评论时触发工作流。: Read lists, stories and comments, and search by keyword; trigger a workflow when someone comments on your story or replies to your comment.
跟踪多少天内的帖子: Track stories from the last N days
链接帖指向的地址；讨论帖与评论为空: Where a link story points; empty for text stories and comments
项目名、域名、仓库地址都行；多个词之间是「且」: A project name, domain or repository address all work; multiple words are ANDed
首页、最新、Ask HN、Show HN 等榜单的前若干条: The top entries of the front page, newest, Ask HN, Show HN and other lists
默认 120，最短 60。HN 的接口免费，但别把它当实时推送用: Default 120, minimum 60. The HN APIs are free, but this is not a real-time push
默认 14：你两周前发的帖子还会有人评论，再早的基本沉了: Default 14: stories from two weeks ago still get comments, older ones have mostly sunk
